758:t_1:839.en:
$$正太郎$$
「If $$鉄人$$ and $$オックス$$ join forces, we won't lose to the likes of the Robot Mafia.」

758:t_1:840.en:
$$マッキー$$
「...All right, $$正太郎$$. Be sure to come home before the ceremony.」

758:t_1:842.en:
$$敷島$$
「$$鉄人$$ and $$オックス$$ are all serviced. You can launch any time.」

758:t_1:843.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Thank you, Doctor. Then I'll be off.」

758:t_1:844.en:
$$正太郎$$
(Let's go, $$鉄人$$... You are the Messenger of the Sun who defends justice.)

758:t_1:845.en:
$$正太郎$$
(I'll keep fighting alongside you from now on. Until the day evil truly vanishes from this world...)

758:t_1:846.en:
$$正太郎$$
(And someday, let's go see everyone. With peace as a souvenir.)

758:t_1:850.en:
$$大塚$$
「...All members of the $$クラッシャー隊$$, are you ready to depart?」

758:t_1:852.en:
$$ナオト$$
「A new mission for the $$クラッシャー隊$$... I'm itching to get started.」

758:t_1:853.en:
$$アキラ$$
「Surveying the Solar System, reborn as a hyperdimensional world... This mission looks like it'll be a long one.」

758:t_1:854.en:
$$ナミダ$$
「Leave the $$クラッシャー隊$$ base to me while you're gone.」

758:t_1:856.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「$$ナミダ$$ has been accepted as a trainee member, after all. I'm counting on you from now on.」

758:t_1:857.en:
$$タケル$$
「By the time $$ナミダ$$ becomes a full member, I bet Earth will be exchanging with all sorts of stars.」

758:t_1:858.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「To prepare for that, I'll go back to the $$ギシン星$$ system once and gather the will of each planet.」

758:t_1:861.en:
$$タケル$$
「Wait for me, $$ロゼ$$. Once I'm done surveying the Solar System, I'm planning to go to $$ギシン星$$ too.」

758:t_1:862.en:
$$タケル$$
「I'll visit the planet where $$ゴッドマーズ$$ and I were born, and renew my vow to peace there.」

758:t_1:864.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「You're going to see everyone in $c, aren't you?」

758:t_1:866.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「$$マーズ$$... Let me come along on that journey, too.」

758:t_1:867.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「So that I can protect this peace together with you.」

758:t_1:869.en:
$$タケル$$
(And thank you, Brother... You live on inside me forever...)

758:t_1:870.en:
$$タケル$$
(Let's protect it together, the love and peace of this universe... That is my fight from here on.)

758:t_1:874.en:
$$デュオ$$
「...Still, all of us getting jobs at the $$プリベンター$$s, huh.」

758:t_1:875.en:
$$カトル$$
「It's true the war is over, but we need to prepare for whatever comes next.」

758:t_1:876.en:
$$トロワ$$
「If you look for the place where the $$ガンダム$$s can be put to the best use, this is the only one.」

758:t_1:877.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Well... Us, sure, but I never thought $$ヒイロ$$ and $$五飛$$ would sign on too.」

758:t_1:878.en:
$$五飛$$
「Now that I know the strength of joining forces, there's no need to cling to pointless pride.」

758:t_1:880.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「...It's almost time to depart. Enough idle chatter.」

758:t_1:881.en:
$$トロワ$$
「Guarding the Gate when it's activated... So that's our first mission.」

758:t_1:882.en:
$$カトル$$
「It looks like the people here to see us off have arrived.」

758:t_1:884.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Don't worry about it. Compared to the center of the galaxy, it's right around the corner.」

758:t_1:885.en:
$$キャスリン$$
「I'll be waiting for you to come back safe, $$トロワ$$.」

758:t_1:886.en:
$$トロワ$$
「I'll be back before the next performance. Tell the ringmaster that, too.」

758:t_1:887.en:
$$サリィ$$
「It suits you, $$五飛$$. The $$プリベンター$$ jacket.」

758:t_1:888.en:
$$五飛$$
「This is the justice I found.」

758:t_1:889.en:
$$ドロシー#pt101$$
「The peace that you Gundam pilots won back for us... I wonder how long it will last.」

758:t_1:890.en:
$$カトル$$
「Keeping it going is the work of everyone living in this world.」

758:t_1:891.en:
$$マリーメイア$$
「Those words... I will engrave them in my heart.」

758:t_1:893.en:
$$レディ$$
「$$ヒイロ$$... You have a visitor, too.」

758:t_1:896.en:
$$ノイン$$
「It wasn't easy, you know. Finding a gap in $$リリーナ$$'s official duties.」

758:t_1:897.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「I got to do one last favor for you as your brother.」

758:t_1:900.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「...It's strange. I had so much I wanted to talk about, and yet now that we're face to face, the words won't come.」

758:t_1:902.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「...It's time. We'll talk next time.」

758:t_1:903.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Yes. Please be sure to come back.」

758:t_1:907.en:
$$トロワ$$
「I suppose that's how $$ヒイロ$$ and $$リリーナ$$ do things.」

758:t_1:909.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Then let's go. I'll take command on site.」

758:t_1:911.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
(I'm going, $$リリーナ$$. Protect the peace of this world...)

758:t_1:912.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
(If anyone appears who stands in your way, I will eliminate them... Even if it costs me my life...)

758:t_1:916.en:
$$マリナ$$
(This flower... It's proof that $$刹那$$ and the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ connected their hearts...)

758:t_1:917.en:
$$クラウス$$
「So how is it, Princess $$マリナ$$? What do you make of seeing the long-awaited $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ flower up close?」

758:t_1:918.en:
$$マリナ$$
「There are things that words cannot express.」

758:t_1:919.en:
$$マリナ$$
「But from that flower, I can feel the feelings of the people who fought in pursuit of peace.」

758:t_1:920.en:
$$シーリン$$
「Sorry to interrupt your reverie, but you have a visitor.」

758:t_1:922.en:
$$刹那$$
「$$マリナ・イスマイール$$...」

758:t_1:925.en:
$$マリナ$$
「Yes... But I always thought we would meet someday.」

758:t_1:926.en:
$$刹那$$
「Because what we seek is the same...」

758:t_1:927.en:
$$刹那$$
「I've come to understand after fighting all this time... You, who rejected fighting, were right.」
